name: Origin Story
source: Taking place twenty years after the Metagen-92 virus – aka the “Superflu” – has swept the world and rendered many of its adult population superpowered or mutated, Origin Story follows MC (name customizable), a seemingly normal nineteen-year-old who in any other universe would be a popular and attractive prospect for most girls. But in this universe, his ability hasn't manifested yet. Shunned by most of his meta-gifted peers, MC finds himself a hapless virgin on the lower rung of his school's social ladder, with only a few misfit friends by his side.
translation: 《起源故事》发生在Metagen-92病毒（又名“超级流感”）席卷世界并导致许多成年人超能力或变异的20年后，讲述的是MC（名字可定制），一个看似正常的19岁女孩，在任何其他宇宙中对大多数女孩来说都是一个受欢迎且有吸引力的前景。但在这个宇宙中，他的能力还没有显现出来。MC被大多数有天赋的同龄人所回避，他发现自己是一个倒霉的处女，在学校的社会阶梯中处于较低的位置，只有几个不合群的朋友在他身边。
